user_request: Build an AI document intelligence platform using AWS. It should allow users to upload PDF documents securely, extract text using OCR, identify PII, and store the metadata in a graph database for relationship querying.
normalized_request: Build an AI document intelligence platform on AWS that securely accepts PDF uploads, extracts text via OCR, detects PII, and stores extracted metadata in a graph database to enable relationship-based querying.

execution_plan.objective: Break down the AI document intelligence platform into functional components: secure PDF upload, OCR text extraction, PII identification, and graph database metadata storage with relationship querying.
Identify public/open-source solutions, libraries, and AWS services for PDF handling, OCR engines, PII detection models, and graph database technologies that could support this platform.
Assess the discovered candidates against requirements: AWS integration, security, accuracy for OCR and PII detection, graph database capabilities, and production-readiness.
Determine for each component whether to REUSE existing solutions, ADAPT open-source projects, or BUILD custom code based on evaluation results.
Create a detailed technical blueprint including architecture diagrams, component integration points, AWS service configuration, deployment workflow, and implementation priorities.
Validate the blueprint against security requirements, AWS best practices, scalability needs, and feasibility of executing the plan with available resources.
